rules_text.final: Final line: even the low end of our range gives it a 70%+ chance, it passes every research check, and it costs 75¢ or less.
rules_text.lean: Lean: our middle number gives it a 70%+ chance and it passes every check, but the low end dips under 70% or one named condition is open.
rules_text.passed: Considered and passed: likely enough by our number but failed a check or the research, priced above 75¢, or a fifth line in one game.
rules_text.value: Price comes second: each line shows what the price needs against our number, but that read never moves a line up or down the card.
rules_text.qb: Games with a backup quarterback stay on the board; his team's receiving lines stay leans until he has started two of its last three games.
